Save recipes with the heart button. Open a recipe to scale ingredient quantities for your table, then add it to a seven-day plan with breakfast, lunch, and dinner slots. Favourites and plans stay in this browser using Local Storage.

Scaled quantity = original quantity × requested servings ÷ original servings. Choose a whole number from 1 to 20. Results round to two decimal places; original units stay the same. “To taste” ingredients do not scale. Preparation time does not scale with servings.

RecipeNest is an educational recipe website built with AngularJS. Recipes, dietary tags and allergens are sample content, and profiles are fictional. The optional assistant uses Ollama Cloud. There are no accounts, payments or email delivery.
Illustrative food photos come from Unsplash and are included locally. They may not depict the exact dish. The gallery captions identify the provider; the
list original image URLs. Interface graphics and layout were created for RecipeNest. AngularJS is included under its MIT licence.

Only recipe identifiers, serving counts and your language choice are saved. The contact form demonstrates validation and stores no message. To reset saved recipes and plans, use your browser's site-data settings for this local address. Storage failures show a message and the app continues in memory for the current tab.
